opening_annotation.professional_name: Zerg Speedling Expand into Baneling Nest
opening_annotation.macro_family: Early Pool with Gas and Queen
opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Fast combat units with early gas for potential banelings, while expanding.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high rate of first combat unit observed (98.87%) compared to baseline (69.83%), indicating early aggression or early defense.
The medoid key sequence is 'Base > Prod_SpawningPool > Gas > Combat_queen > Combat_ling_bane', showing early spawning pool and gas before combat units.
The profile shows investment in economy (0.4615) and expansion (0.3205), with some ground investment (0.2769), but no air, defense, or upgrade investment.
The winning trace seeds show variations in order of queen and ling-bane, but all include spawning pool and gas before combat units.
